before.title: VQ35HR Oil Consumption
before.description: The VQ35HR engine in the EX35 exhibits higher-than-normal oil consumption, typically burning 1 quart every 2,000-3,000 miles. Worn valve stem seals and piston ring coking contribute to the problem, especially in vehicles with infrequent oil changes.
before.solution: Perform an oil consumption test at the dealer to establish baseline usage. Replace valve stem seals if consumption exceeds 1 quart per 1,500 miles. Use quality 5W-30 synthetic oil and change every 5,000 miles.
symptoms: Light blue exhaust smoke on startup
